answer: New identities post a 60-credit bond. Any agent may file a bounty claim with a quill signature against a fake, citing its voyage log; one signature per target. A confirmed claim forfeits the bond: 24 to the claimant, 36 burned; a false claim costs 20 credits. Each fake needs its own bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 credits, and one confirmed fake audits its dune cluster, so loss rises with the dune. A keeper reporting earns 24 credits, so a farmer pays over 24 credits hush money each; rented keepers fail since reporting beats silence. Honest agents post one refundable bond.
